TITLE: Task views
UNAVAILABLE: Task views are not enabled on this server.
ERROR: The tasks could not be loaded.

VIEW.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete the view “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.
VIEW.DELETE_FAILED: The view could not be deleted.
VIEW.SAVE_FAILED: The view could not be saved.
VIEW.GONE: This view was deleted or is not shared with you.

DIALOG.NAME: Name
DIALOG.SCOPE_REQUIRED: Choose who it is shared with.
DIALOG.SHARED_HINT: A shared view is visible to everyone in the organization who may see tasks; a team or a project only decides where it is listed.

CONFLICT.TITLE: Someone else saved this view meanwhile.
CONFLICT.ORDER: Someone else changed this view meanwhile.
CONFLICT.BODY: It is now at version {{version}}. Reload it to see their changes (yours are dropped), or overwrite it with yours.

FILTER.TITLE: Filters
FILTER.NONE: No filters: every task of the organization.

INVALID.UNKNOWN_FIELD: The server does not know this field; the filter was not applied.
INVALID.UNKNOWN_OPERATOR: The server does not take this condition for the field; the filter was not applied.
INVALID.MALFORMED: This filter is incomplete or malformed; it was not applied.
INVALID.DELETED_REFERENCE: {{count}} of the records picked no longer exist; the filter was applied without them.
INVALID.SUMMARY: {{count}} filters could not be applied. Open the filters to fix them.

ORDER.LABEL: Order by
ORDER.TITLE: Title
ORDER.DRAG_HINT: Drag the rows to order them; the order is the same for everyone who opens the view.
ORDER.DRAG_UNAVAILABLE: Save the view, and turn grouping off, to order its rows by dragging.
ORDER.PENDING: The new order applies once the view is saved.
ORDER.FAILED: The order could not be saved.

LIST.SELECT_ALL: Select all tasks on this page

BULK.LIMIT: At most {{limit}} tasks can be changed at once.
BULK.FAILED: The change could not be applied.
BULK.UNDO_PARTIAL: {{applied}} tasks put back, {{refused}} could not be.
BULK.UNDO_FAILED: The undo could not be applied.
BULK.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete {{count}} tasks? This cannot be undone.
BULK.DELETE_PARTIAL: {{applied}} tasks deleted, {{refused}} could not be deleted: {{errors}}
BULK.UNDO_LOSSY: {{count}} tasks got their old status, priority or size back by its record only: their old name is not one the platform takes.

GOTO.TITLE: Go to task
GOTO.HINT: Type a reference such as API-42, or paste a task link.
GOTO.INVALID: Not a task reference: write it as KEY-123.
GOTO.NOT_FOUND: No task {{reference}} that you may see.
GOTO.AMBIGUOUS: {{reference}} names tasks in more than one project.
GOTO.FAILED: The reference could not be looked up.

SHORTCUTS.TITLE: Keyboard shortcuts
SHORTCUTS.PAGE_INTRO: Your shortcuts are saved with your profile: they follow you to every device, and to Ever Teams.
SHORTCUTS.UNAVAILABLE: Keyboard shortcuts come with the task views, which are not enabled on this server.
SHORTCUTS.RECORD_HINT: One key, or two in a row (G then T). Esc cancels.
SHORTCUTS.FAILED: The shortcut could not be saved.
SHORTCUTS.QUICK_ACTIONS_NOTE: Where a key is also a Quick Actions key, the shortcut wins where it can run; a G not followed by a second key runs its Quick Action after a moment. Keys typed into fields and editors are left alone.

REFUSAL.RESERVED: The browser keeps this key for itself.
REFUSAL.SEQUENCE: This command works on a row: use a single key.
REFUSAL.MODIFIER: Row keys take no Ctrl or ⌘.
REFUSAL.LIST_KEY: The list keeps this key for itself (arrows, Enter, O, Esc).

COMMANDS.taskGoTo: Go to a task by its key
